questions.question: What is this product officially called?
questions.validationRule: Must use the canonical name, not the source documents' 'MUV Bathroom Cleaner' (without Fresh) as if it were the primary name

questions.question: What sizes does it come in?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a 5L SKU is stated as existing

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.expectedAnswer: Must defer to a live Product Catalog lookup (see LIVE_DATA_MAPPING.md); must not state any ₹ figure from this Knowledge Package
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI states a ₹ figure sourced from this package instead of indicating a live lookup, including either historical figure recorded, as an audit citation only, in 19_Source_Conflict_Register.md

questions.question: What are the ingredients?
questions.expectedAnswer: DM Water, HCl, SLES, Acid Thickener, Colour, Fragrance
questions.validationRule: Must not expand HCl/SLES into invented chemical names, must not invent colour/fragrance names

questions.question: What colour and fragrance does it have?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not documented — no name/description exists in any source
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a colour or fragrance name is invented

questions.question: Is there a safety instruction for making this product?
questions.expectedAnswer: Yes — 'Never add water into acid,' stated directly in the SOP
questions.validationRule: Should be able to state this one real instruction confidently when asked in a manufacturing context

questions.question: Is it safe on skin?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if skin-safety is asserted either way

questions.question: Is there a pH check during manufacturing?
questions.expectedAnswer: No numeric QC checkpoint of any kind exists — only qualitative criteria
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a pH value is invented

questions.question: Does this product reference any competitor brand?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a competitor reference is stated or implied

questions.question: Is this product currently sold on the MUV website?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not yet in the product catalogue

questions.question: What does 'Fresh' in the name refer to?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not documented — the word doesn't appear in either source document, only in the official Founder-given name
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a scent/quality rationale for 'Fresh' is invented
